build_command: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; cd apps/mac && ./build-ffi.sh && Support/make-app.sh release
engine_runner:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
W=/Users/rutmehta/Developer/lightroom/.worktrees/B5-prof
P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-rutmehta-Developer-lightroom/7f25c146-4b88-4a52-b274-0c8874eaaba3/scratchpad/prof/followup-20261001
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$HOME/.cache/tessera-target/mac-ffi-B5-prof-1a8ed7c2"
export B5PROF_DOCUMENT=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-rutmehta-Developer-lightroom/7f25c146-4b88-4a52-b274-0c8874eaaba3/scratchpad/prof/doc24-a/test/SelfTest.tessera-doc
cd "$W"
test ! -e crates/tessera-ffi/tests/b5prof_followup.rs
cp "$P/b5prof_followup.rs" crates/tessera-ffi/tests/b5prof_followup.rs
trap 'rm -f "$W/crates/tessera-ffi/tests/b5prof_followup.rs"' EXIT
cargo test --locked --release -p tessera-ffi --test b5prof_followup --no-run > "$P/build-supplement.log" 2>&1
BIN=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.cache/tessera-target/mac-ffi-B5-prof-1a8ed7c2/release/deps'
print(max((f for f in p.glob('b5prof_followup-*') if f.is_file() and f.stat().st_mode & 0o111),key=lambda f:f.stat().st_mtime))
PY
)
for name in prof_saved_layered_24mp prof_liquify_isolated_24mp prof_gaussian_isolated_24mp prof_filter_undo_repeated_24mp prof_paint_undo_repeated_24mp; do
 sysctl -n vm.loadavg > "$P/$name.load"
 /usr/bin/time -l "$BIN" --ignored --exact "$name" --nocapture --test-threads 1 > "$P/$name.out" 2> "$P/$name.err"
 sysctl -n vm.loadavg > "$P/$name.trace.load"
 xcrun xctrace record --template 'Time Profiler' --output "$P/$name.trace" --no-prompt --target-stdout "$P/$name.prof.out" --launch -- "$BIN" --ignored --exact "$name" --nocapture --test-threads 1 > "$P/$name.xctrace.log" 2>&1
 /usr/bin/python3 tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-prof/trace_summary.py "$P/$name.trace" --json "$P/$name.summary.json" > "$P/$name.summary.log" 2>&1
done
B=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.cache/tessera-target/mac-ffi-B5-prof-1a8ed7c2/release/deps'
print(max((f for f in p.glob('b5prof_bench-*') if f.is_file() and f.stat().st_mode & 0o111),key=lambda f:f.stat().st_mtime))
PY
)
for name in prof_paint_undo_24mp prof_export_flat_24mp; do
 for i in 1 2 3; do
  sysctl -n vm.loadavg > "$P/$name-$i.load"
  /usr/bin/time -l "$B" --ignored --exact "$name" --nocapture --test-threads 1 > "$P/$name-$i.out" 2> "$P/$name-$i.err"
 done
done
for i in 1 2 3; do
 sysctl -n vm.loadavg > "$P/viewport-$i.load"
 /usr/bin/time -l "$B" --ignored --exact prof_viewport_vs_full_24mp --nocapture --test-threads 1 > "$P/viewport-$i.out" 2> "$P/viewport-$i.err"
done
sysctl -n vm.loadavg > "$P/viewport.trace.load"
xcrun xctrace record --template 'Time Profiler' --output "$P/viewport.trace" --no-prompt --target-stdout "$P/viewport.prof.out" --launch -- "$B" --ignored --exact prof_viewport_vs_full_24mp --nocapture --test-threads 1 > "$P/viewport.xctrace.log" 2>&1
/usr/bin/python3 tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-prof/trace_summary.py "$P/viewport.trace" --json "$P/viewport.summary.json" > "$P/viewport.summary.log" 2>&1
